experiment: formation-ice-channel / research_plan item 1: external anchor verification (Lindqvist 1989) + same-caliber conversion
decision: Decide whether the external quantitative anchor (Lindqvist 1989 three-component ice resistance) may be used as a validated reference for the formation-ice-channel case, and if so, how large the domain-experiment deviation is.
alternatives: A1: anchor is verbatim-verified against the primary paper AND convertible to this case's caliber -> allowed as a validation reference; deviation reported as an error gate.

A2: anchor is verbatim-verified but the case's geometry (rectangular box hull, Cb=1, stem angle 90 deg) lies outside the formula's domain -> anchor usable only as an order-of-magnitude baseline, deviation cannot be called a validation error.
A3: anchor cannot be verbatim-verified offline -> anchor is WITHHELD; the case's domain results must NOT be graded against it, and the conversion is reported as an implementation-caliber number only.
hypothesis: H1 (falsifiable): the Lindqvist (1989) POAC'89 text is present/readable in this sandbox and its three components can be transcribed verbatim with page/table numbers. H1 is falsified if no primary text is reachable offline and network egress is blocked.
metrics: M1 verbatim_anchor_completeness: count of {quote, page_or_table, value} triples transcribed from the primary paper (target 4: R_ice, R_c, R_b, R_s).

M2 recompute_residual: max relative difference between the artifact's reported component values and an independent closed-form re-evaluation (target < 1e-9), plus inverse-solve residual for h (target < 1e-9).
M3 dimensional_homogeneity: number of components failing the SI base-exponent test for force (target 0 failures).
M4 internal_consistency: number of failing analytic identities out of the declared set (target 0 failures).
M5 domain_vs_anchor_relative_deviation: (R_dem_lead - R_anchor)/R_anchor over the declared caliber band (reported, not gated, while M1 fails).
baseline_or_control: Repo implementation of the Lindqvist structure in src/tensordem/level_ice/formula.py (structure grade REAL, coefficient grade WITHHELD per COEFFICIENT_LEDGER) used as the caliber-conversion vehicle; the DEM domain result for this case is the lead-hull mean ice load 82.66 kN (docs/formation_ice_channel_cloud.md section 4.1).

thresholds_predeclared.M1_pass: all four components carry a verbatim quote with page or table number from the primary paper
thresholds_predeclared.M5_role: informational while M1 fails; no pass/fail grade is assigned

stopping_rule: Stop after: one offline source search audit (declared path list + network probe) and one full evaluation of M2-M5. No additional search iterations and no threshold revision after inspecting results.

controlled: case geometry L=80 m, B=20 m, box hull Cb=1
varied: stem/entry angle alpha in {15, 20, 30} deg (literature-typical band; the case hull is a box i.e. alpha=90 deg, outside the formula domain)

confounders: The case field is broken ice (77 discs, mean radius 4.88 m, coverage 0.80) whereas Lindqvist is a level-ice formula: a material model-form mismatch, not a numerical error.
The case hull is a rectangular box with a vertical stem: alpha -> 90 deg makes the crushing term diverge, so any finite alpha is an out-of-domain substitution.
sigma_f and the three pinned coefficients (0.25, 0.9, 0.05) are graded CONVENTION/WITHHELD, so the converted number inherits that grade.
repetitions: Deterministic closed-form evaluation (no stochastic sampling); the sampling variability of the domain result is carried by the existing U95 of the CLOUD artifact, not re-sampled here.

environment.network_egress: probed and reported in the artifact

analysis_predeclared: Values are injected into the artifact by benchmarks/anchors/formation_ice_channel_anchor.py only (no hand-typed numbers in the JSON); the JSON stores per-criterion pass/fail, the measured value, and the script path.
safety_and_resource_limits: Closed-form evaluation only; single process; < 60 s; no cluster use; no file writes outside the repository worktree.
interpretation_limits: A pass on M2/M3/M4 certifies arithmetic and dimensional bookkeeping of the conversion, NOT agreement with the published paper. While M1 fails, no statement in this experiment may be read as literature validation.
